method: A live fullscreen game session was switched through the in-game language menu to Русский VN. macOS captured each stable screen at native resolution; the locale label was added afterward without resizing the source frame.

screenshots.review: Localized high-resolution title buttons are centered, legible, and not clipped.
Russian labels render without missing glyphs; the repaired НАЗАД button is visible below the farm selector.
Save metadata and the НАЗАД button render without clipping or missing glyphs.
Inventory labels, currency, date, and farm metadata render with the locale-specific fonts.
Options labels, checkboxes, and dropdown text are readable and remain within the menu bounds.

smapiLog.note: The log records the exact custom locale, all three locale-specific asset loads, the repaired native back-label overlay, and no ERROR or WARN entries.
